action_conditioned_outcome.evidence: known-effect uplift from the one-factor-daily randomized offer arm (P(buy|offer=opt) - P(buy|off>=2), >= 10 arm-days/side): 233 holdout B customers identified from 724, head fitted on 609 A customers; brain OOS R2=-0.006 vs population-constant naive R2=-0.002; Spearman(brain,truth)=0.044; paired MSE-gain 95%CI [-0.00093,0.00081] (gate lo>0)

distance_regression.evidence: lab-truth latent distance (x0/h0/d0/price_sens/return_prone/touch_pref, z-scored) vs distance over 20000 customer pairs from 724 holdout B customers: donor Spearman 0.124 vs naive bag-of-event-types 0.181; paired-over-pairs gain 95%CI [-0.058,-0.058] (gate lo>0); diagnostic raw-state(pre-boundary) Spearman 0.067
